title: That All You Got (Chas McIvor)
style: country blues acoustic guitar warm baritone male vocal storytelling 108bpm walking bass brushed drums honest rugby character portrait true story first grade Australian
lyrics:
[Intro - country blues acoustic, warm and wide]
First grade.
You don't get there by accident.
Your body knows things
The rest of you hasn't thought about yet.

[Verse 1]
They came at him from behind
Which is how cowards come
Two of them, big ones
The kind that get called for that sort of work
They thought they had him
And then they learned something
About what first grade rugby teaches
When someone puts weight on your back

[Verse 2]
He rolled
The way a trained man rolls
Not away from them
Just off them
The way you clear a ruck
When the ref is watching
Which they weren't
But his body didn't know that
His body just did what it knows
And suddenly he was standing
And they were not where they expected to be

[Chorus]
That all you got, boys
He said it easy
That all you got, boys
Turned around from a recovered position
That all you got, boys
Standing clean in the car park
That all you got, boys
Two men much bigger than most
And Joel Aaron McIvor
Looking at them square
That all you got

[Bridge - spoken, dry and respectful]
First grade is specific training.
Chas played. Pete played. Joel played.
Corey found different water.
But this night was first grade at real-world scale.
Rolled two guards off his back.
Stood up.
Asked a reasonable question.
They did not have more.
As it turned out.

[Verse 3]
It wasn't aggression
It was economy
The minimum required to establish the fact
And then the question
Delivered calmly
To two men who'd underestimated
What first grade means
When you're not on a field anymore

[Chorus reprise]
That all you got, boys
Recovered position
That all you got, boys
Joel Aaron McIvor
First grade
Swan River blood
McIvor male line
That all you got

[Outro - guitar alone, settled]
Dad played
Pete played
Joel played
Corey found the ocean
But the family knows
What to do when something comes from behind
They just do it in different shapes
The shape this night was Joel
Standing
Asking
